answer_2.quote: For the Overall Score dimension, we use macro-F1 score (F1) and accuracy (Acc) as the evaluation indicators of the effect, which measures the overlap of the predicted score and the ground truth.

answer_3.quote: GPT4 ZeroShot: GPT4 (OpenAI, 2023), known as a leading large language model (LLM), is employed in its zero-shot variant to assess its capability in evaluating web page quality.
